model: nonnegative additive latency over candidate-specific physical work
validation: leave-one-complete-scenario-family-out; all seeds remain in the same fold
scientific_boundary: This is grouped development validation, not an independent holdout.
The model ranks only candidates already admitted by hard governance checks.
A failed gate is retained and does not authorize another threshold search.
A pass authorizes one separately frozen holdout, not a paper performance claim.
